description: Between Center City Philadelphia and Chestnut Hill East
advisory:
No Parking in North Lot at Chestnut Hill East Station

The North Lot at Chestnut Hill East Station is closed for stormwater and restoration work until further notice.

Chestnut Hill East Station ADA-Accessible, High-Level Platform Opens Mon., Oct. 12

Riders at Chestnut Hill East Station have access to the new ADA-accessible, high-level platform for both inbound and outbound trains beginning Monday, October 12. Construction continues at this station until further notice, so please observe posted signs and use caution. Thank you for your support and patience as we work to complete station renovations.

Train 2740 Schedule Adjusted to Accommodate Wilmington/Newark Shuttle Busing

On October 17-18 and October 24-25, train 2740 operates up to 22 minutes later than scheduled time from Claymont to Chestnut Hill East. View the Chestnut Hill East PDF schedule or visit septa.org.

New Regional Rail Schedules, October 18

New Regional Rail schedules go into effect on Sunday, October 18. Visit septa.org for schedule update highlights and new PDFs schedules for each impacted line.

Chestnut Hill East Station Parking Lot Update

Only 18 parking spots (including 1 ADA spot) are designated for customers on East Chestnut Hill Ave., alongside the South lot. Additionally, no overnight parking is allowed at Chestnut Hill East Station until construction is completed.
